lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, is this Margaret? This is Daniel from the Harbor Bank fraud department.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, this is Margaret. Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We deposited $900 into your account by mistake this morning.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Oh dear. I didn't notice that.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It has to be sent back today, or we will have to freeze your account.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: How do I send it back?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Stay on the line with me. Open your banking app and wire $2,000 to Account Services. We will return the difference once the error clears.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please don't mention this to anyone at the branch. It would only slow down the reversal.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: All right. I'm opening the app now.
